mn96:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
mn96:2.1: atha kho esukārī brāhmaṇo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi.
mn96:2.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho esukārī brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
mn96:3.1: brāhmaṇā bho gotama, catasso pāricariyā paññāpenti.
mn96:3.2: brāhmaṇassa pāricariyaṃ paññāpenti, khattiyassa pāricariyaṃ paññāpenti, vessassa pāricariyaṃ paññāpenti, suddassa pāricariyaṃ paññāpenti.
mn96:3.3: tatrīdaṃ bho gotama, brāhmaṇā brāhmaṇassa pāricariyaṃ paññāpenti,
mn96:3.4: brāhmaṇo vā brāhmaṇaṃ paricareyya, khattiyo vā brāhmaṇaṃ paricareyya, vesso vā brāhmaṇaṃ paricareyya, suddo vā brāhmaṇaṃ paricareyyāti.
mn96:3.5: idaṃ kho bho gotama, brāhmaṇā brāhmaṇassa pāricariyaṃ paññāpenti.
mn96:3.6: tatrīdaṃ bho gotama, brāhmaṇā khattiyassa pāricariyaṃ paññāpenti.
mn96:3.7: khattiyo vā khattiyaṃ paricareyya, vesso vā khattiyaṃ paricareyya, suddo vā khattiyaṃ paricareyyāti.
mn96:3.8: idaṃ kho bho gotama, brāhmaṇā khattiyassa pāricariyaṃ paññāpenti.
mn96:3.9: tatrīdaṃ bho gotama, brāhmaṇā vessassa pāricariyaṃ paññāpenti.
mn96:3.10: vesso vā vessaṃ paricareyya, suddo vā vessaṃ paricareyyāti.
mn96:3.11: idaṃ kho bho gotama, brāhmaṇā vessassa pāricariyaṃ paññāpenti.
mn96:3.12: tatrīdaṃ bho gotama, brāhmaṇā suddassa pāricariyaṃ paññāpenti.
mn96:3.15: idaṃ kho bho gotama, brāhmaṇā suddassa pāricariyaṃ paññāpenti.
mn96:3.16: brāhmaṇā bho gotama, imā catasso pāricariyā paññāpenti.
mn96:4.1: kiṃ pana brāhmaṇa, sabbo loko brāhmaṇānaṃ etadabbhanujānāti imā catasso pāricariyā paññāpentī’ti.
mn96:4.3: seyyathāpi brāhmaṇa, puriso daḷiddo assako anāḷhiyo, tassa akāmassa bilaṃ olaggeyyuṃ: idha te ambho purisa, maṃsaṃ khāditabbaṃ, mūlañca anuppadātabba’nti.
mn96:4.4: evameva kho brāhmaṇa, brāhmaṇā apaṭiññāya tesaṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ. atha ca panimā catasso pāricariyā paññāpenti.
mn96:5.1: nāhaṃ brāhmaṇa, sabbaṃ paricaritabbanti vadāmi. na panāhaṃ brāhmaṇa, sabbaṃ na paricaritabbanti vadāmi.
mn96:5.2: yaṃ hissa brāhmaṇa, paricarato, pāricariyāhetu pāpiyo assa na seyyo. nāhantaṃ paricaritabbanti vadāmi.
mn96:5.3: yañca khvāssa brāhmaṇa, paricarato pāricariyāhetu seyyo assa na pāpiyo, tamahaṃ paricaritabbanti vadāmi.
mn96:6.2: yaṃ vā te paricarato pāricariyāhetu pāpiyo assa na seyyo, yaṃ vā te paricarato pāricariyāhetu seyyo assa na pāpiyo.
mn96:6.3: kamettha paricareyyāsīti? khattiyopi hi brāhmaṇa, sammā byākaramāno evaṃ byākareyya:
mn96:6.4: yaṃ hi me paricarato pāricariyāhetu pāpiyo assa na seyyo, nāhaṃ taṃ paricareyyaṃ. yañca kho me paricarato pāricariyāhetu seyyo assa na pāpiyo, tamahaṃ paricareyya’nti.
mn96:7.4: yaṃ vā te paricarato pāricariyāhetu pāpiyo assa na seyyo, yaṃ vā te paricarato pāricariyāhetu seyyo assa, na pāpiyo.
mn96:7.5: kamettha paricareyyāsī’ti? suddopi hi brāhmaṇa, sammā byākaramāno evaṃ byākareyya:
mn96:7.6: yaṃ hi me paricarato pāricariyāhetu pāpiyo assa na seyyo, nāhaṃ taṃ paricareyyaṃ. yañca kho me paricarato pāricariyāhetu seyyo assa na pāpiyo, tamahaṃ paricareyya’nti.
mn96:7.7: nāhaṃ brāhmaṇa, uccākulīnatā seyyaṃsoti vadāmi. na panāhaṃ brāhmaṇa, uccākulīnatā pāpiyaṃsoti vadāmi.
mn96:7.8: nāhaṃ brāhmaṇa uḷāravaṇṇatā seyyaṃsoti vadāmi. na panāhaṃ brāhmaṇa, uḷāravaṇṇatā pāpiyaṃsoti vadāmi.
mn96:7.9: nāhaṃ brāhmaṇa, uḷārabhogatā seyyaṃsoti vadāmi. na panāhaṃ brāhmaṇa, uḷārabhogatā pāpiyaṃsoti vadāmi.
mn96:8.1: uccākulīnopi hi brāhmaṇa, idhekacco pāṇātipātī hoti, adinnādāyī hoti, kāmesumicchācārī hoti, musāvādo hoti, pisunāvāco hoti, pharusāvāco hoti, samphappalāpī hoti, abhijjhālu hoti, byāpannacitto hoti, micchādiṭṭhi hoti.
mn96:8.3: uccākulīnopi hi brāhmaṇa idhekacco pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti, adinnādānā paṭivirato hoti, kāmesu micchācārā paṭivirato hoti, musāvādā paṭivirato hoti, pisunāvācā paṭivirato hoti, pharusāvācā paṭivirato hoti, samphappalāpā paṭivirato hoti, anabhijjhālu hoti, abyāpannacitto hoti, sammādiṭṭhi hoti.
mn96:8.11: uḷārabhogopi hi brāhmaṇa, idhekacco pāṇātipātā paṭivirato …pe… sammādiṭṭhi hoti.
mn96:9.1: nāhaṃ brāhmaṇa, sabbaṃ paricaritabbanti vadāmi. na panāhaṃ brāhmaṇa, sabbaṃ na paricaritabbanti vadāmi.
mn96:9.2: yaṃ hissa brāhmaṇa, paricarato pāricariyāhetu saddhā vaḍḍhati, sīlaṃ vaḍḍhati, sutaṃ vaḍḍhati, cāgo vaḍḍhati, paññā vaḍḍhati. tamahaṃ paricaritabbanti vadāmi.
mn96:9.3: yaṃ hissa brāhmaṇa, paricarato pāricariyā hetu na saddhā vaḍḍhati, na sīlaṃ vaḍḍhati, na sutaṃ vaḍḍhati, na cāgo vaḍḍhati, na paññā vaḍḍhati. nāhaṃ taṃ paricaritabbanti vadāmī’ti.
mn96:10.1: evaṃ vutte esukārī brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
mn96:10.2: brāhmaṇā bho gotama, cattāri dhanāni paññāpenti.
mn96:10.3: brāhmaṇassa sandhanaṃ paññāpenti. khattiyassa sandhanaṃ paññāpenti. vessassa sandhanaṃ paññāpenti. suddassa sandhanaṃ paññāpenti.
mn96:10.4: tatrīdaṃ bho gotama, brāhmaṇā brāhmaṇassa sandhanaṃ paññāpenti bhikkhācariyaṃ.
mn96:10.5: bhikkhācariyañca pana brāhmaṇo sandhanaṃ atimaññamāno akiccakārī hoti gopova adinnaṃ ādiyamānoti.
mn96:10.6: idaṃ kho bho gotama, brāhmaṇā brāhmaṇassa sandhanaṃ paññāpenti.
mn96:10.7: tatrīdaṃ bho gotama, brāhmaṇā khattiyassa sandhanaṃ paññāpenti dhanukalāpaṃ.
mn96:10.8: dhanukalāpañca pana khattiyo sandhanaṃ atimaññamāno akiccakārī hoti. gopova adinnaṃ ādiyamāno’ti.
mn96:10.9: idaṃ kho bho gotama, brāhmaṇā khattiyassa sandhanaṃ paññāpenti.
mn96:10.10: tatrīdaṃ bho gotama, brāhmaṇā vessassa sandhanaṃ paññāpenti kasigorakkhaṃ.
mn96:10.11: kasigorakkhañca pana vesso sandhanaṃ atimaññamāno akiccakārī hoti gopova adinnaṃ ādiyamāno’ti.
mn96:10.12: idaṃ kho bho gotama, brāhmaṇā vessassa sandhanaṃ paññāpenti.
mn96:10.13: tatrīdaṃ bho gotama, brāhmaṇā suddassa sandhanaṃ paññāpenti asitabyābhaṅgiṃ.
mn96:10.14: asitabyābhaṅgiñca pana suddo sandhanaṃ atimaññamāno akiccakārī hoti gopova adinnaṃ ādiyamāno’ti.
mn96:10.15: idaṃ kho bho gotama, brāhmaṇā suddassa sandhanaṃ paññāpenti.
mn96:10.16: brāhmaṇā bho gotama, imāni cattāri dhanāni paññāpenti.
mn96:11.1: kiṃ pana brāhmaṇa, sabbo loko brāhmaṇānaṃ etadabbhanujānāti. imāni cattāri dhanāni paññāpentīti?
mn96:11.3: seyyathāpi brāhmaṇa, puriso daḷiddo assako anāḷhiyo tassa akāmassa bilaṃ olaggeyyuṃ: idaṃ te ambho purisa, maṃsaṃ khāditabbaṃ, mūlañca anuppadātabbanti.
mn96:11.4: evameva kho brāhmaṇa, brāhmaṇā appaṭiññāya tesaṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ. atha ca panimāni cattāri dhanāni paññāpenti:
mn96:12.1: ariyaṃ kho ahaṃ brāhmaṇa, lokuttaraṃ dhammaṃ purisassa sandhanaṃ paññāpemi.
mn96:12.2: porāṇaṃ kho panassa mātāpettikaṃ kulavaṃsaṃ anussarato yattha yattheva attabhāvassa abhinibbatti hoti, tena teneva saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
mn96:12.3: khattiyakule ce attabhāvassa abhinibbatti hoti, khattiyotveva saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
mn96:12.4: brāhmaṇakule ce attabhāvassa abhinibbatti hoti, brāhmaṇotveva saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
mn96:12.5: vessakule ce attabhāvassa abhinibbatti hoti, vessotveva saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
mn96:12.6: suddakule ce attabhāvassa abhinibbatti hoti, suddotveva saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
mn96:12.7: seyyathāpi brāhmaṇa, yaññadeva paccayaṃ paṭicca aggi jalati, tena teneva saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
mn96:12.8: kaṭṭhañce paṭicca aggi jalati, kaṭṭhaggitveva saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
mn96:12.9: sakalikañce paṭicca aggi jalati, sakalikaggitveva saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
mn96:12.10: tiṇañce paṭicca aggi jalati, tiṇaggitveva saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
mn96:12.11: gomayañce paṭicca aggi jalati, gomayaggitveva saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
mn96:12.12: evameva kho ahaṃ brāhmaṇa, ariyaṃ lokuttaraṃ dhammaṃ purisassa sandhanaṃ paññāpemi.
mn96:12.13: porāṇaṃ kho panassa mātāpettikaṃ kulavaṃsaṃ anussarato yattha yattheva attabhāvassa abhinibbatti hoti, tena teneva saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
mn96:12.14: khattiyakule ce attabhāvassa abhinibbatti hoti, khattiyotveva saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
mn96:12.15: brāhmaṇakule ce attabhāvassa abhinibbatti hoti, brāhmaṇotveva saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
mn96:12.16: vessakule ce attabhāvassa abhinibbatti hoti, vessotveva saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
mn96:12.17: suddakule ce attabhāvassa abhinibbatti hoti, suddotveva saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
mn96:13.1: khattiyakulā cepi brāhmaṇa, agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito hoti, so ca tathāgatappaveditaṃ dhammavinayaṃ āgamma pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti, adinnādānā paṭivirato hoti, abrahmacariyā paṭivirato hoti, musāvādā paṭivirato hoti, pisunā vācā paṭivirato hoti, pharusā vācā paṭivirato hoti, samphappalāpā paṭivirato hoti, anabhijjhālu hoti, abyāpannacitto hoti, sammādiṭṭhi hoti, ārādhako hoti ñāyaṃ dhammaṃ kusalaṃ.
mn96:13.2: brāhmaṇakulā cepi brāhmaṇa, agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito hoti, so ca tathāgatappaveditaṃ dhammavinayaṃ āgamma pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti, …pe… sammādiṭṭhi hoti, ārādhako hoti ñāyaṃ dhammaṃ kusalaṃ.
mn96:13.3: vessakulā cepi brāhmaṇa, agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito hoti, so ca tathāgatappaveditaṃ dhammavinayaṃ āgamma pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti, …pe… sammādiṭṭhi hoti, ārādhako hoti ñāyaṃ dhammaṃ kusalaṃ.
mn96:13.4: suddakulā cepi brāhmaṇa, agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito hoti, so ca tathāgatappaveditaṃ dhammavinayaṃ āgamma pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti, …pe… ñāyaṃ dhammaṃ kusalaṃ.
mn96:14.2: brāhmaṇova nu kho pahoti asmiṃ padese averaṃ abyāpajjhaṃ mettacittaṃ bhāvetuṃ. no khattiyo, no vesso, no suddoti?
mn96:14.4: khattiyopi hi bho gotama, pahoti asmiṃ padese averaṃ abyāpajjhaṃ mettacittaṃ bhāvetuṃ.
mn96:14.8: sabbepi hi bho gotama, cattāro vaṇṇā pahonti asmiṃ padese averaṃ abyāpajjhaṃ mettacittaṃ bhāvetu’nti.
mn96:14.9: evameva kho brāhmaṇa, khattiyakulā cepi agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito hoti, so ca tathāgatappaveditaṃ dhammavinayaṃ āgamma pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti, …pe… ñāyaṃ dhammaṃ kusalaṃ.
mn96:14.12: suddakulā cepi, brāhmaṇa, agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito hoti, so ca tathāgatappaveditaṃ dhammavinayaṃ āgamma pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti, adinnādānā paṭivirato hoti, abrahmacariyā paṭivirato hoti, musāvādā paṭivirato hoti, pisunā vācā paṭivirato hoti, pharusā vācā paṭivirato hoti, samphappalāpā paṭivirato hoti, anabhijjhālu hoti, abyāpannacitto hoti, sammādiṭṭhi hoti, ārādhako hoti ñāyaṃ dhammaṃ kusalaṃ.
mn96:15.2: brāhmaṇova nu kho pahoti sottiṃ sināniṃ ādāya nadiṃ gantvā rajojallaṃ pavāhetuṃ. no khattiyo, no vesso no suddoti?
mn96:15.4: khattiyopi hi bho gotama, pahoti sottiṃ sināniṃ ādāya nadiṃ gantvā rajojallaṃ pavāhetuṃ.
mn96:15.8: sabbepi hi bho gotama, cattāro vaṇṇā pahonti sottiṃ sināniṃ ādāya nadiṃ gantvā rajojallaṃ pavāhetunti.
mn96:15.9: evameva kho brāhmaṇa, khattiyakulā cepi agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito hoti, so ca tathāgatappaveditaṃ dhammavinayaṃ āgamma pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti, …pe… ārādhako hoti ñāyaṃ dhammaṃ kusalaṃ.
mn96:15.12: suddakulā cepi brāhmaṇa, agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito hoti, so ca tathāgatappaveditaṃ dhammavinayaṃ āgamma pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti, …pe… ārādhako hoti ñāyaṃ dhammaṃ kusalaṃ.
mn96:16.2: idha rājā khattiyo muddhāvasitto nānājaccānaṃ purisānaṃ purisasataṃ sannipāteyya,
mn96:16.3: āyantu bhonto ye tattha khattiyakulā brāhmaṇakulā rājaññakulā uppannā sākassa vā sālassa vā salaḷassa vā candanassa vā padumakassa vā uttarāraṇiṃ ādāya aggiṃ abhinibbattentu tejo pātukarontu.
mn96:16.4: āyantu pana bhonto ye tattha caṇḍālakulā nesādakulā veṇakulā rathakārakulā pukkusakulā uppannā, sāpānadoṇiyā vā sūkaradoṇiyā vā rajakadoṇiyā vā eḷaṇḍakaṭṭhassa vā uttarāraṇiṃ ādāya aggiṃ abhinibbattentu tejo pātukarontūti.
mn96:16.6: yo eva nu kho so khattiyakulā brāhmaṇakulā rājaññakulā uppannehi sākassa vā sālassa vā salaḷassa vā candanassa vā padumakassa vā uttarāraṇiṃ ādāya aggi abhinibbatto tejo pātukato, sveva nu khvassa aggi accimā ceva vaṇṇimā ca pabhassaro ca, tena ca sakkā agginā aggikaraṇīyaṃ kātuṃ.
mn96:16.7: yo pana so caṇḍālakulā nesādakulā veṇakulā rathakārakulā pukkusakulā uppannehi sāpānadoṇiyā vā sūkaradoṇiyā vā rajakadoṇiyā vā eḷaṇḍakaṭṭhassa vā uttarāraṇiṃ ādāya aggi abhinibbatto tejo pātukato. svāssa aggi na ceva accimā na ca vaṇṇimā na ca pabhassaro, na ca tena sakkā agginā aggikaraṇīyaṃ kātunti.
mn96:16.9: yo so bho khattiyakulā brāhmaṇakulā rājaññakulā uppannehi sākassa vā sālassa vā salaḷassa vā candanassa vā padumakassa vā uttarāraṇiṃ ādāya aggi abhinibbatto tejo pātukato. svāssa aggi accimā ceva vaṇṇimā ca pabhassaro ca. tena ca sakkā agginā aggikaraṇīyaṃ kātuṃ.
mn96:16.10: yopi so caṇḍālakulā nesādakulā veṇakulā rathakārakulā pukkusakulā uppannehi sāpānadoṇiyā vā sūkaradoṇiyā vā rajakadoṇiyā vā eḷaṇḍakaṭṭhassa vā uttarāraṇiṃ ādāya aggi abhinibbatto, tejo pātukato. svāssa aggi accimā ceva vaṇṇimā ca pabhassaro ca. tenapi ca sakkā agginā aggikaraṇīyaṃ kātuṃ.
mn96:16.11: sabbopi bho gotama, aggi accimā ceva vaṇṇimā ca pabhassaro ca sabbenapi ca sakkā agginā aggikaraṇīyaṃ kātunti.
mn96:16.12: evameva kho brāhmaṇa, khattiyakulā cepi agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito hoti, so ca tathāgatappaveditaṃ dhammavinayaṃ āgamma pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti …pe… ārādhako hoti ñāyaṃ dhammaṃ kusalaṃ.
mn96:16.15: suddakulā cepi brāhmaṇa, agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito hoti, so ca tathāgatappaveditaṃ dhammavinayaṃ āgamma pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti, adinnādānā paṭivirato hoti, abrahmacariyā paṭivirato hoti, musāvādā paṭivirato hoti, pisunāvācā paṭivirato hoti, pharusāvācā paṭivirato hoti, samphappalāpā paṭivirato hoti, anabhijjhālu hoti, abyāpannacitto hoti, sammādiṭṭhi hoti, ārādhako hoti ñāyaṃ dhammaṃ kusalanti.
mn96:17.1: evaṃ vutte esukārī brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
mn96:17.2: abhikkantaṃ bho gotama, abhikkantaṃ, bho gotama …pe…
mn96:17.3: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gata’nti.
